admissible_evidence.reason: The evidence explicitly states 'Male sex... was consistently associated with increased antibody responses across the serological assays,' directly supporting the claim that men have higher antibody levels after COVID-19 exposure. The association holds across multiple assays and remains significant even when accounting for other factors like age and hospitalization.
